description: Bookit Master Configuration — 30+ Skills, XDEV Protocol, Iron Rules (v8.2.2)

ironRules.rule_minus_1: MemPalace mandatory: status → search before decisions
ironRules.rule_0: Encoding check on Cyrillic Edit/Write (b'\xd0\xa0\xc2' in raw)
ironRules.rule_0_5: All UI text through /humanizer (except aria-label, data-testid, dates)
ironRules.rule_1: QA-GATE: clarify → plan → approve → code (no code without alignment)
ironRules.rule_2: XDEV protocol: read SKILL_PROTOCOL.md, AI_DEVELOPER.md before work
ironRules.rule_3: Skills Decision Tree: clarify 3-5 Q → select skill → launch with context
ironRules.rule_4: No-Emoji Policy: only Lucide React icons in UI
ironRules.rule_5: Full production-grade: never lite, always premium

codeReview.description: Code quality, security, best practices, OWASP audit

designAudit.description: Design audit, anti-pattern detection, 27-rule quality gate

designGenerate.description: Generate premium UI code (PRIMARY UI generator)

seniorBackend.description: API, database, Server Actions, Supabase RPC

nextjsBestPractices.description: Next.js routing, SSR, ISR, caching, App Router

claudeAPI.description: Claude API, Anthropic SDK, prompt caching, agents

schedule.description: Cron jobs, scheduled agents, recurring tasks

mempalace.usagePattern: MANDATORY: mempalace_status on wake-up, mempalace_search before decisions, mempalace_add_drawer after important fixes

supabase.usagePattern: Direct DB access for migrations, RLS checks, RPC functions

tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS v4 utilities, color generation, config
tailwind.usagePattern: CSS → Tailwind conversion, color palette generation, utility lookup

a11y.usagePattern: MANDATORY after color selection: check contrast, find light/dark pair

universal-icons.description: Icon search (10+ collections: Lucide, Material, Heroicons, Phosphor, FontAwesome)
universal-icons.usagePattern: Find icons from any collection; prefer Lucide for BookIT

clarificationFramework.description: SMART SKILL SELECTION: Ask 3-5 clarifying questions BEFORE launching skill
clarificationFramework.protocol: clarify → plan → approve → skill selection → launch → QA
workflow: 3. Ask 3-5 clarification questions via AskUserQuestion (per CLARIFICATION_FRAMEWORK.md)
6. Select precise skill + parameters from Decision Tree
9. QA gate with user (mandatory for design/copy)

questions: 1. Scope: new component, page section, full page, or dashboard widget?
2. Aesthetic: premium minimalist, harsh brutalist, warm editorial?
3. Colors: which theme (Blossom/Studio/Frost) or custom palette?
4. Motion: animations/transitions needed? (yes/no/maybe)
5. Priority: is this high-impact or low-priority polish?
1. Type: button label, feature description, landing copy, or error message?
2. Tone: professional, playful, urgent, friendly, premium?
3. Audience: beauty professionals, clients, or both?
4. Constraints: max length, avoid certain words, SEO priority?
5. Context: is this for UI, marketing, or notification?
1. Focus: performance, security, architecture, or general quality?
2. Scope: single file, entire component, feature, or full system?
3. Context: what's the issue or desired outcome?
4. Severity: critical production bug, tech debt, or improvement?
5. Output: code fix, audit report, or refactor plan?
1. Type: entrance, exit, state change, or scroll-triggered?
2. Feel: snappy, bouncy, smooth, or elegant?
3. Scope: single element or complex multi-element sequence?
4. Devices: desktop, mobile, or both?
5. Performance: is this smooth on low-end devices?
1. What system: settings.json, hooks, cron, or env vars?
2. Scope: setup new, debug existing, or migrate config?
3. Impact: local only, dev server, or production?

skipClarificationWhen: Simple fixes (typo, variable name, single-line change)
Explicit spec provided (exact screenshot, detailed design doc, code snippet)
Follow-up to already-answered questions (user is responding to your Q1-Q5)
Explicitly requested (user says 'skip questions' or 'just do it')
Technical lookup (grep, read code, verify something)

graphifyConfig.description: Auto-track code changes & maintain architecture graph index

onGlobGrep.trigger: Glob or Grep tool use (PreToolUse hook)
onGlobGrep.action: graphify_hook.py → auto-log accessed files → update graph-index.json

onEditWrite.trigger: Edit or Write tool use (PostToolUse hook)
onEditWrite.action: post_edit_hook.py → auto-log modified files + encoding check → update graph-index.json

onGitCommit.action: Could run graphify-cli to regenerate GRAPH_REPORT.md (future enhancement)

onDemand.action: Run graphify-cli manually or via cron

navigation.recommendation: Use MemPalace + SYSTEM_MAP.md for project navigation
navigation.reason: Graphify is Obsidian-indexed; better for context preservation

whatIsTracked: Timestamp + change type for each operation
trackingDetails.privacy: All tracking local to project; no external calls

designComplete.name: Complete Design Workflow (Comprehensive)
steps: 2. Ask 5 Q via AskUserQuestion (scope, aesthetic, colors, motion, priority)
6. Launch /design-taste-frontend with { theme, palette, scope, animation }

copywriting.name: Copy/Text Humanization Workflow
steps: 2. Ask 5 Q: type, tone, audience, constraints, length
4. /humanizer with context: { type, tone, audience, constraints }

codeReview.name: Code Review & Security Audit Workflow
steps: 2. Ask 5 Q: focus, scope, context, severity, output
5. Generate audit report or fix code
6. If fixes: /run → npm run build → npm run test:e2e

animation.name: Animation & Motion Polish Workflow
steps: 2. Ask 5 Q: type, feel, scope, devices, performance

alwaysUse: 🎯 ASK CLARIFICATIONS FIRST — 3-5 questions before skill launch (MANDATORY)
🧠 MemPalace MANDATORY: status on wake-up, search before decisions, drawer after fixes
📝 humanizer for ALL text (buttons, labels, messages, copy — except aria-label, dates, console)
🔍 impeccable for design audit (27-rule anti-pattern check)
🎯 tailwind for CSS optimization (convert, generate colors, validate)
📦 Full production-grade: never lite, always premium
designPhilosophy: Blossom (Light Taupe): warm, elegant, Editorial (Kinfolk aesthetic)
Studio (Dark Teal): harsh, expensive, Brutal aesthetic (Aesop aesthetic)
Frost (Ice Lavender): cool, premium, modern (Monocle aesthetic)
Three themes consistent: same layout, different colors via CSS vars
Framer Motion v12.35.1 mandatory for all animations
Mobile-first Tailwind v4 (@import 'tailwindcss' in globals.css, no tailwind.config.ts)
Server Components by default, 'use client' only for interactivity
Lucide React icons ONLY (wrap in span for style prop, never use emoji)
codePhilosophy: Server Components default, proper 'use client' boundary
Supabase RLS on every table (security first)
pluralUk() for Ukrainian plurals (never ad-hoc ternary)
TanStack Query v5 with staleTime per hook type
Vaul BottomSheet for mobile drawers (NEVER bare framer-motion)
no-emoji in UI code: use Lucide icons + style props
RLS + RPC for complex queries with aggregates
Service role operations ONLY via createAdminClient() from @/lib/supabase/admin
postChangeChecklist: 6. Graphify check (optional: run graphify-cli for graph refresh)
7. Git commit with Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5

onSessionStart: ✅ 4. If task = code, read XDEV/AI_DEVELOPER.md (8 iron rules)
✅ 5. If task = design, read XDEV/UX_STANDARDS.md (3 themes, rules)
✅ 6. Clarify with user (3-5 questions per framework)
beforeEachCode: ✅ Test locally (npm run build, npm test)
